stories.headline: US Series A funding reached $42B through October, up 60% year over year, while deal count stayed flat
stories.quote: U.S. startups have raised $42 billion in Series A funding this year through October, marking a 60% year-over-year increase.

facts.text: Annual number of Series A rounds of $1M or more averaged 1,200 from 2023 through 2025.
facts.quote: From 2023 through 2025, the annual number of Series A rounds at $1 million or more averaged 1,200.

facts.text: 2026 deal count is in line with that trend; funding has almost doubled versus 2023.
facts.quote: 2026 has largely held that trend, give or take 100 deals. Series A funding has soared each year over the same period, almost doubling so far in 2026 versus 2023.

facts.text: Gartner reported in October that memory prices more than doubled in 12 months.
facts.quote: Data center demand has more than doubled the price of memory over the past 12 months, tech research firm Gartner

stories.headline: Linq raised $90M in a round led by Andreessen Horowitz
stories.quote: Linq, a San Francisco-based provider of messaging, voice and computing infrastructure for AI agents, raised $90 million in a round. AndreessenHorowitz led the round and was joined by existing investors TQ Ventures, MuckerCapitalAbstract, and others.
stories.description: Messaging, voice and computing infrastructure for AI agents

stories.headline: Ansa Biotechnologies raised $71.5M Series C led by Blue Water Life Science Advisors
stories.quote: Ansa Biotechnologies, an Emeryville, Calif.-based DNA synthesis company, raised $71.5 million in Series C funding. BlueWaterLifeScienceAdvisors led the round and was joined by IlluminaVentures, BEVC, LightscapePartners, AgentCapital, and existing investors.

stories.headline: Pulley announced $64M in new funding: a $41M Series B and a $23M Series A
stories.quote: Pulley , a San Francisco-based AI startup, announced $64 million in new funding, which includes a $41 million Series B and a $23 million Series A. Investors include Jump Capital, Catalyst Investors, CRV and Susa Ventures.
stories.stage_as_written: a $41 million Series B and a $23 million Series A

facts.text: The $64M total is made up of a $41M Series B and a $23M Series A.
facts.quote: announced $64 million in new funding, which includes a $41 million Series B and a $23 million Series A.

stories.headline: Arva AI raised $20M Series A led by Arthur Ventures
stories.quote: Arva AI, a New York City- and London-based developer of AI models and agents for banking operations, raised $20 million in Series A funding. Arthur Ventures led the round and was joined by YCombinator and GradientVentures.
stories.description: AI models and agents for banking operations

stories.headline: Voyage Labs raised $12M seed led by Kleiner Perkins
stories.quote: Voyage Labs, a Menlo Park, Calif.-based startup building a personal AI agent that plans and books trips and local outings, raised $12 million in seed funding. KleinerPerkins led the round and was joined by SignalFire, SVAngel, and angel investors.
stories.description: Personal AI agent that plans and books trips and local outings

stories.headline: Vero Security raised $11M seed led by TLV Partners
stories.quote: Vero Security, a New York- and Tel Aviv-based company designed to help enterprises enforce security policies for AI tools and agents, raised $11 million in seed funding. TLV Partners led the round and was joined by GTMCapital, MapleCapital, and angel investors.
stories.description: Helps enterprises enforce security policies for AI tools and agents

stories.headline: each::labs raised $7M seed from Revo Capital and others
stories.quote: each::labs, a San Francisco-based platform for generating images, video and audio, raised $7 million in seed funding from RevoCapital and others.
stories.description: Platform for generating images, video and audio

stories.headline: Omega Systems, backed by Revelstoke Capital Partners, acquired Framework IT; terms not disclosed
stories.quote: Framework IT, a Chicago-based provider of managed IT, cybersecurity, and AI services. Financial terms were not disclosed.
stories.description: Provider of managed IT, cybersecurity, and AI services

facts.text: Acquirer Omega Systems is backed by Revelstoke Capital Partners.

stories.headline: CSI Companies acquired HCTec from Claritas Capital and TruArc Partners; terms not disclosed
stories.quote: HCTec, a Nashville-based provider of managed IT services and staffing for health systems, from Claritas Capital and TruArc Partners. Financial terms were not disclosed.
stories.description: Managed IT services and staffing for health systems

stories.headline: UPS agreed to acquire Smartways from The Riverside Company
stories.quote: Smartways, a New South Wales, Australia and Auckland, New Zealand-based healthcare logistics provider designed to transport time-critical medical technologies and life sciences, from TheRiversideCompany.
stories.description: Healthcare logistics provider for time-critical medical technologies and life sciences

facts.text: UPS has agreed to the acquisition; the seller is The Riverside Company.
